Context: None

Question: Aren't you supposed to be teaching a history class?

Options: 
A. No because we have not still learned from our past history.
B. No because all of the books have changed.
C. No because history is always changing and I can't keep up. 
D. No because no one signed up for my class.

Provide the correct letter choice in \boxed{X}, where X is the correct letter choice. Keep the explanation or feedback within 3 sentences.
